gaps.explanation: 'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
